text: 10月22日，有市场消息称，国内大模型公司DeepSeek（深度求索）拟在最新一轮融资中筹得约1000亿元人民币（约150亿美元），腾讯和宁德时代为本轮出资最多的投资方，交易预计在未来数日内正式完成。截至目前，DeepSeek及腾讯等相关投资方均未公开回应。记者从接近公司和投资方的多个信源交叉求证，确认上述消息属实。消息人士透露，本轮募资目标最初设定为500亿元，此后经多轮上调至约1000亿元，目前尚未官宣，最终金额仍未完全确定。这笔资金将继续用于模型训练、算力建设和人才招募，以支撑DeepSeek参与全球竞争。也有部分消息人士判断，本轮融资将为公司筹备
text_en: On October 22, market reports said that domestic large-model company DeepSeek plans to raise about RMB 100 billion (about USD 15 billion) in its latest funding round, with Tencent and CATL the largest investors in the round, and the deal expected to be formally completed within the next few days. As of now, DeepSeek and related investors such as Tencent have not publicly responded. The reporter cross-verified with multiple sources close to the company and investors and confirmed that the reports are accurate. Sources said the fundraising target was initially set at RMB 50 billion and was raised through multiple rounds to about RMB 100 billion; it has not yet been officially announced and the final amount is not fully determined. The funds will continue to be used for model training, computing power buildout and talent recruitment to support DeepSeek's participation in global competition.
